functions.name: Abs
functions.description: Distance from zero. Abs(-8) is 8. Also accepts a Double and returns Double; keep argument types consistent.

functions.name: Min
functions.signature: Min(first As Number, second As Number) As Number
functions.description: The smaller value. Also accepts two Doubles. Useful for limiting a player's position.

functions.name: Max
functions.signature: Max(first As Number, second As Number) As Number
functions.description: The larger value. Also accepts two Doubles. Max(0, Health - Damage) keeps health from becoming negative.

functions.name: ToDouble
functions.description: Explicitly converts a whole Number to Double. Very large integers can lose precision in binary64.

functions.name: ToNumber
functions.description: Truncates toward zero: ToNumber(7.9) is 7. Out-of-range conversion fails.

functions.name: Clamp
functions.signature: Clamp(value As Double, minimum As Double, maximum As Double) As Double
functions.description: Keeps a Double between its bounds. Use Clamp(Health, 0.0, 100.0) for Double values; minimum must not exceed maximum.

functions.name: Sqrt
functions.description: Square root. Sqrt(25.0) is 5.0. Negative input fails.

functions.name: Sin
functions.description: Sine of an angle in radians. Use it for waves, bobbing objects, and circular motion.

functions.name: Cos
functions.description: Cosine of an angle in radians. Pair with Sin for circular motion.

functions.name: Atan2
functions.signature: Atan2(y As Double, x As Double) As Double
functions.description: Direction angle in radians from a pair of coordinates.

functions.name: Floor
functions.description: Rounds down: Floor(-1.2) is -2.0. The result stays Double.

functions.name: Ceiling
functions.description: Rounds up: Ceiling(1.2) is 2.0. The result stays Double.

functions.name: Truncate
functions.description: Drops the fractional part toward zero. The result stays Double.

functions.name: Round
functions.description: Rounds to the nearest whole value, with exact halves going to the even value: Round(2.5) is 2.0 and Round(3.5) is 4.0.

functions.name: Text_Length
functions.description: Counts Unicode scalar values. This is character-oriented text processing, not a UTF-8 byte count.

functions.name: Text_Code_At
functions.signature: Text_Code_At(text As Text, index As Number) As Number
functions.description: Returns a Unicode scalar at zero-based index, or -1 if the index is outside the text.

functions.name: Text_Slice
functions.signature: Text_Slice(text As Text, start As Number, count As Number) As Text
functions.description: Takes a Unicode scalar slice. A negative start, nonpositive count, or start beyond the end returns empty text; a long count clamps to the available text.

functions.name: Text_From_Double
functions.description: Converts a finite Double to culture-independent round-trip text, such as 2.5.

functions.name: Text_To_Double
functions.description: Parses a finite decimal/exponent value using a decimal point. Malformed or nonfinite text fails; use with controlled input.

functions.name: Timer
functions.description: Returns elapsed milliseconds from the runtime timer. Compare two readings to measure elapsed time.

functions.name: Game_Closed
functions.description: True when the game window has closed. Use it as a game-loop exit condition.

functions.name: Window_Width
functions.description: Returns the logical canvas width.

functions.name: Window_Height
functions.description: Returns the logical canvas height.

functions.name: Window_Title
functions.description: Changes the native window title or Web document title.

functions.name: Window_Activate
functions.description: Restores/requests focus for a native game window and reports success. Web currently returns False.

functions.name: Window_Loading
functions.description: Shows the shared loading presentation again. Load a scene after success; the next Show Screen completes the transition after the minimum display time.

functions.name: Window_DeferClose
functions.description: Enables or disables deferred closing. Native apps can offer save/discard/cancel. Web requests the browser's own unsaved-work prompt, subject to browser policy.

functions.name: Window_CloseRequested
functions.description: Consumes a deferred native close request once. Web returns False because tab-close confirmation belongs to the browser.

functions.name: Key_Held
functions.description: Reads the current live held state. Use with KEY_LEFT, KEY_RIGHT, or another named key for continuous movement.

functions.name: Key_Event_Held
functions.description: Reads which named keys were held when the most recent queued Get Key event occurred. Useful for a quick Control+Arrow shortcut.

functions.name: Pointer_X
functions.description: Logical canvas x coordinate of the latest pointer position.

functions.name: Pointer_Y
functions.description: Logical canvas y coordinate of the latest pointer position.

functions.name: Pointer_Delta_X
functions.description: Accumulated x movement in this frame. Show Screen clears frame deltas.

functions.name: Pointer_Delta_Y
functions.description: Accumulated y movement in this frame. Show Screen clears frame deltas.

functions.name: Pointer_Wheel_Delta
functions.description: Wheel movement accumulated during this frame, cleared by Show Screen.

functions.name: Pointer_Wheel_Remainder
functions.description: Native raw wheel units retained below one 120-unit step; Web currently returns zero.

functions.name: Pointer_Inside
functions.description: Whether the latest pointer position is inside the logical game canvas.

functions.name: Pointer_Held
functions.description: True while a contact owns the chosen button role; held state remains across frames.

functions.name: Pointer_Pressed
functions.description: True if this button was pressed during the current frame; read before Show Screen.

functions.name: Pointer_Released
functions.description: True if this button was released during the current frame; read before Show Screen.

functions.name: Rgb
functions.signature: Rgb(red As Number, green As Number, blue As Number) As Number
functions.description: Builds a color from red, green, and blue components. Use values from 0 to 255.

functions.name: Image_Width
functions.description: Original pixel width of a loaded image.

functions.name: Image_Height
functions.description: Original pixel height of a loaded image.

functions.name: Image_Loaded
functions.description: Checks whether an Image holds a loaded resource.

functions.name: Text_Width
functions.signature: Text_Width(text As Text, size As Number) As Number
functions.description: Measures text using the target's drawing engine; use it to lay out a label.

functions.name: Text_Height
functions.signature: Text_Height(text As Text, size As Number) As Number
functions.description: Measures text height. Positive text sizes give a positive height even for empty text.

functions.name: File_Export
functions.signature: File_Export(fileName As Text, contents As Text) As Boolean
functions.description: Requests a user-chosen UTF-8 file export. Native uses a file dialog; Web requests a download. Success on Web means the request was accepted, not proof the file reached disk.

functions.name: File_Import
functions.description: Requests user-chosen UTF-8 text. Empty, canceled, and unavailable results all return empty text; trigger it from an explicit user action.

functions.name: File_Reveal
functions.description: Native helper to reveal an existing absolute Windows drive path in the file manager. Returns False where unavailable; it is not a portable game-asset loader.

functions.name: Renderer3D
functions.signature: Renderer3D(command As Number, a As Number, b As Number, c As Number, d As Number, e As Number, f As Number, g As Number, h As Number, i As Number, j As Number) As Number
functions.description: Low-level renderer command bridge used by Smile.Simple3D. Learn Graphics3D, Precision3D, and ArenaViewport3D instead of inventing command numbers.

functions.name: Renderer3DImage
functions.signature: Renderer3DImage(command As Number, image As Image, a As Number, b As Number, c As Number, d As Number, e As Number, f As Number, g As Number, h As Number) As Number
functions.description: Image-to-renderer bridge used by the library's texture/material operations.

functions.name: Renderer3DText
functions.signature: Renderer3DText(command As Number, text As Text, a As Number, b As Number, c As Number, d As Number, e As Number, f As Number, g As Number, h As Number) As Number
functions.description: Text-to-renderer bridge used by the library's resource operations.

functions.name: Renderer3DTextValue
functions.signature: Renderer3DTextValue(command As Number, a As Number, b As Number, c As Number, d As Number, e As Number, f As Number, g As Number, h As Number, i As Number) As Text
functions.description: Renderer query bridge with a Text result; use the named library wrapper.

functions.name: Renderer3DDouble
functions.signature: Renderer3DDouble(command As Number, resource As Number, a As Double, b As Double, c As Double, d As Double, e As Double, f As Double, g As Double, h As Double, i As Double, j As Double, k As Double, l As Double) As Number
functions.description: Typed precision bridge. Command/resource are Number; the twelve value slots are Double. High-level precision modules own scene state.

functions.name: Renderer3DDoubleValue
functions.signature: Renderer3DDoubleValue(command As Number, resource As Number, index As Number, component As Number) As Double
functions.description: Queries a Double value from the renderer through a named library wrapper.
